title: Search results
description: What an adapter returns: a list of results, or an object carrying the list plus the real cost and status.

usd.description: Actual cost of this request in US dollars, if the service reports it.

units.description: Optional. The cost in the service's own billing units (tokens, credits), e.g. {"tokens": 5}.

total.description: Optional. How many records matched in all, when the service says (a database lists more than one call returns).

url.description: A web URL, or any stable identifier for a record with none (e.g. urn:event:<id>). Non-web identifiers are never shown to reviewers.

published.description: ISO date or timestamp, or an RFC 2822 date. Unknown is null.

excerpt.description: The text the service returned for the result; the runner keeps 700 characters.

occurred.description: Optional. The date the service gives the occurrence itself (clusters and event records), ISO.

first_seen.description: Optional. When the service first stored the record (ingest time), ISO timestamp. Used for timeliness.

place.description: Optional. The place the service assigns.
